related.title: 非球面光學加工
related.transfer: 可遷移「磁流變效應與降伏應力流體帶」與「面形量測、CGH 零檢與去除點校正」的建模、量測與誤差預算方法；非球面光學加工的元件、尺度與允收條件需重新設定。
related.transferEn: The modelling, measurement and error-budget methods of "Magnetorheological effect and the yield-stress ribbon" and "Figure metrology, CGH null test and spot calibration" transfer, while components, scales and acceptance conditions of Aspheric-optics manufacturing must be respecified.
related.difference: 本課聚焦以磁場硬化的磁流變液帶、Preston 去除關係與去除點校正，確定性修正非球面面形；非球面光學加工則以非球面矢高方程、中頻誤差、確定性拋光、鑽石車削與模造、非球面量測與對心公差為重點，不能直接沿用參數或允收值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on deterministic aspheric figure correction with a field-stiffened MR ribbon, Preston removal relation and spot calibration; Aspheric-optics manufacturing centres on aspheric sag equation, mid-spatial-frequency error, deterministic polishing, diamond turning and molding, asphere metrology and centring tolerances, so parameters and acceptance values do not transfer unchanged.
practice: 比較系統邊界：列出「磁流變液帶與電磁鐵」與「非球面矢高方程與圓錐常數」的輸入、輸出與主要干擾。
把本課算例的一個假設移到非球面光學加工，標出可沿用的方程與必須重設的參數。
以「非球面對心靈敏度與誤差預算」為例，設計一項能區分兩種系統的驗證量測，並註明不確定度。
practiceEn: Compare system boundaries: list the inputs, outputs and main disturbances of “MR ribbon and electromagnet” and “Aspheric sag equation and conic constant”.
Move one assumption of this course's worked example to Aspheric-optics manufacturing, separating reusable equations from parameters that must be respecified.
Using "Aspheric centring sensitivity and the error budget", design a verification measurement that distinguishes the two systems and state its uncertainty.

related.title: 離子束光學表面修形
related.transfer: 可遷移「磁流變效應與降伏應力流體帶」與「面形量測、CGH 零檢與去除點校正」的建模、量測與誤差預算方法；離子束光學表面修形的元件、尺度與允收條件需重新設定。
related.transferEn: The modelling, measurement and error-budget methods of "Magnetorheological effect and the yield-stress ribbon" and "Figure metrology, CGH null test and spot calibration" transfer, while components, scales and acceptance conditions of Ion-beam figuring of optical surfaces must be respecified.
related.difference: 本課聚焦以磁場硬化的磁流變液帶、Preston 去除關係與去除點校正，確定性修正非球面面形；離子束光學表面修形則以以濺射去除函數與駐留時間反卷積，把拋光後的面形誤差收斂到奈米級為重點，不能直接沿用參數或允收值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on deterministic aspheric figure correction with a field-stiffened MR ribbon, Preston removal relation and spot calibration; Ion-beam figuring of optical surfaces centres on converging polished figure error to the nanometre level with a sputter removal function and dwell-time deconvolution, so parameters and acceptance values do not transfer unchanged.
practice: 比較系統邊界：列出「磁流變液帶與電磁鐵」與「氬離子束與工件表面」的輸入、輸出與主要干擾。
把本課算例的一個假設移到離子束光學表面修形，標出可沿用的方程與必須重設的參數。
以「誤差預算與收斂極限」為例，設計一項能區分兩種系統的驗證量測，並註明不確定度。
practiceEn: Compare system boundaries: list the inputs, outputs and main disturbances of “MR ribbon and electromagnet” and “Argon-ion beam and workpiece surface”.
Move one assumption of this course's worked example to Ion-beam figuring of optical surfaces, separating reusable equations from parameters that must be respecified.
Using "Error budget and convergence limit", design a verification measurement that distinguishes the two systems and state its uncertainty.

history.year: 公開工程脈絡 / Public engineering context
history.title: 磁流變光學拋光
history.text: 磁流變拋光的概念由 William Kordonski 與同事在 1980 年代末於明斯克提出，1990 年代在羅徹斯特大學光學製造中心由 Jacobs、Golini 與 Kordonski 等人發展成確定性的光學修形技術，1996 年成立的 QED Technologies 把它商品化為數控機台，2001 年該技術獲得美國國防部的製造技術獎。此後磁流變拋光成為非球面、自由曲面與高功率雷射光學的標準修形工具，與離子束修形互補。本課只重建公開的物理與工程邏輯，不涉及任何流體配方。
history.textEn: The magnetorheological finishing concept was proposed by William Kordonski and colleagues in Minsk in the late 1980s, developed in the 1990s at the University of Rochester Center for Optics Manufacturing by Jacobs, Golini, Kordonski and others into a deterministic optical figuring technique, commercialised as CNC machines by QED Technologies, founded in 1996, and recognised with a U.S. Department of Defense manufacturing-technology award in 2001. MRF has since become a standard figuring tool for aspheres, freeforms and high-power laser optics, complementary to ion-beam figuring. This course reconstructs only public physics and engineering logic, not any fluid formulation.

history.title: 從工程史到可驗證模型
history.titleEn: From engineering history to verifiable models
history.text: 本課把「磁流變效應與降伏應力流體帶」到「規格換算、驗收與工程交接」改寫為 32 個原創分析、量測與診斷任務；不複製來源圖片、影片逐字稿或現場程序。
history.textEn: The course turns "Magnetorheological effect and the yield-stress ribbon" through "Specification conversion, acceptance and engineering handoff" into 32 original analysis, measurement and diagnosis tasks without copying source images, video transcripts or field procedures.
